_meta.description: Hand-curated lat/lng for high-MW EA Register projects not in REPD. Sources are public — operator announcements, planning portals, OS maps, news coverage. Used as a third geocoder by scripts/join_ea_to_repd.py after REPD lookup and before substation fallback.

Hinkley Point C.source: EDF Energy site, OS NGR ST205465
Hinkley Point C.notes: Reactor footprint, ~3km north of Hinkley Point substation

Aquind Interconnector.source: Aquind planning application, Eastney Beach Portsmouth landing point
Aquind Interconnector.notes: UK-France HVDC; lands at Eastney, cables to Lovedean GSP

NeuConnect Interconnector.source: NeuConnect project page, Isle of Grain UK landing
NeuConnect Interconnector.notes: UK-Germany HVDC, 1.4 GW, connects to Grain GSP

Nautilus.source: Nautilus project documents, proposed Friston Suffolk landing

Eggborough CCGT - OCGT - BESS.source: OS map, former Eggborough coal station footprint
Eggborough CCGT - OCGT - BESS.notes: EP UK Investments redevelopment; CCGT/OCGT/BESS site

STALLINGBOROUGH CARBON CAPTURE CCGT.source: Stallingborough industrial estate, Humber CCS cluster
STALLINGBOROUGH CARBON CAPTURE CCGT.notes: VPI Holding CCS project, North Lincs

Kintore Electrolysis.source: Storegga Acorn Project site, St Fergus Gas Terminal
Kintore Electrolysis.notes: Three EA Register entries totalling 2.5 GW electrolyser capacity at St Fergus

Cottam Giga.source: Former Cottam Power Station footprint, OS NGR SK820795

IPC Grid Tremorfa.notes: Industrial estate adjacent to Tata Steel Cardiff

Thurrock Power Station.notes: Three EA entries at same site — Tilbury/Thurrock CCGT

Rampion Extension Offshore Wind Farm.notes: Sussex coast offshore wind farm extension

Morecambe Offshore Wind Farm.source: Cobra/Flotation Energy project boundary, Morecambe Bay
Morecambe Offshore Wind Farm.notes: Floating offshore wind off Lancashire coast

Salamander Offshore Wind Farm.source: Salamander Floating Wind project area, off Peterhead
Salamander Offshore Wind Farm.notes: Pilot floating offshore wind off Aberdeenshire

CENOS.source: CENOS floating wind project area, north of mainland Scotland
CENOS.notes: Floating offshore wind north of Caithness

Sundon DC.source: Sundon GSP area, Bedfordshire (approximate — exact site not public)
Sundon DC.notes: 600 MW data centre near Sundon substation

Horsey.source: Horsey, Somerset (near Bridgwater) — assumed based on connection point
